title: Pure Xtra HERO
summary: The Xtra HERO Link Monster lineup—Xtra HERO Cross Crusader, Xtra HERO Wonder Driver, Xtra HERO Infernal Devicer, and Xtra HERO Dread Decimator—serves as the tactical backbone uniting the Elemental, Destiny, and Vision HERO sub-archetypes! Start with Vision HERO Faris + Increase + Vyon (or A Hero Lives into Elemental HERO Stratos) to dump Destiny HERO - Malicious and Link Summon Xtra HERO Cross Crusader, which revives Malicious and tributes it to search any HERO monster from your Deck! Next, Link Summon Xtra HERO Infernal Devicer to reveal Elemental HERO Flame Wingman in your Extra Deck and add its listed Normal Monster materials from your Deck to your hand, while Xtra HERO Wonder Driver resets Polymerization, Miracle Fusion, or Mask Change directly from your GY whenever a HERO is summoned to its arrow. Finish by climbing into Link-3 Xtra HERO Dread Decimator, which grants itself and all HERO monsters it points to piercing battle damage and +100 ATK for every differently named HERO in your GY!

allow.Fusion Destiny: Normal Spell that Fusion Summons Destiny HERO - Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer using materials directly from your hand and Deck—loading Destiny HERO - Malicious and Denier into your GY for Xtra HERO Cross Crusader to revive and Tribute!
allow.E - Emergency Call: Normal Spell that adds any 'Elemental HERO' monster (Stratos, Shadow Mist, or Liquid Soldier) from your Deck to your hand.
allow.A Hero Lives: Normal Spell that pays half your LP while you control no face-up monsters to Special Summon Elemental HERO Stratos or Shadow Mist directly from your Deck.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: adds any Level 4 or lower Warrior HERO monster from your Deck to your hand.

main: Elemental HERO Stratos
Core Level 4 WIND Warrior starter: adds any 'HERO' monster from your Deck to your hand on Normal or Special Summon, or destroys Spells/Traps up to the number of other HERO monsters you control.
Elemental HERO Shadow Mist
Level 4 DARK Warrior: adds 'Mask Change' from your Deck to your hand when Special Summoned, or adds any 'HERO' monster (except itself) from your Deck to your hand when sent to the GY.
Elemental HERO Liquid Soldier
Level 4 WATER Warrior: revives a Level 4 or lower HERO from your GY on Normal Summon, and draws 2 cards (discarding 1) when used as Fusion Material for a HERO Fusion Monster.
Vision HERO Faris
Core Level 5 DARK Warrior starter: discards 1 other HERO monster to Special Summon itself from your hand and places 'Vision HERO Increase' from your Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone.
Vision HERO Increase
Tributes 1 HERO monster during the Main Phase while in your Spell & Trap Zone to Special Summon itself and Special Summon 'Vision HERO Vyon' directly from your Deck.
Vision HERO Vyon
Sends any 'HERO' monster (Destiny HERO - Malicious or Elemental HERO Shadow Mist) from your Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon, and banishes 1 HERO from your GY to search 'Polymerization'!
Destiny HERO - Malicious

Core Level 6 DARK Warrior extender: banishes itself from your GY to Special Summon another copy of Malicious from your Deck—providing free Link Material and Tribute fodder for Xtra HERO Cross Crusader!
Destiny HERO - Denier

Level 3 DARK Warrior: Special Summons itself from your hand or GY once per Duel if a Destiny HERO is on your field or in your GY, and places 1 of your banished Destiny HERO - Malicious back on top of your Deck for a third summon!
Destiny HERO - Plasma

Level 8 DARK Warrior floodgate boss (searchable by Xtra HERO Cross Crusader!): Special Summons itself by Tributing 3 monsters (easily assembled via Cross Crusader + Malicious + Denier!) and negates the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent controls!
Elemental HERO Neos
Level 7 LIGHT Warrior (searchable by Xtra HERO Infernal Devicer revealing Shining Neos Wingman!) used for Favorite Contact and Flame Wingman - Infernal Rage.
Fusion Destiny
Fuses Malicious + Denier directly from your Deck into Destiny HERO - Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer, loading your GY with Destiny HEROes for Xtra HERO Cross Crusader!
A Hero Lives
Special Summons Elemental HERO Stratos or Shadow Mist directly from your Deck without using your Normal Summon.
E - Emergency Call
Searches Elemental HERO Stratos, Shadow Mist, or Liquid Soldier.
Mask Change
Quick-Play Spell (reset from your GY by Xtra HERO Wonder Driver!) that sends a DARK HERO to the GY to Special Summon Masked HERO Dark Law.
Polymerization
Searched by Vision HERO Vyon and reset from your GY by Xtra HERO Wonder Driver!
Miracle Fusion
Searched by Elemental HERO Sunrise and reset from your GY by Xtra HERO Wonder Driver!
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Stratos or Faris.
Favorite Contact

Searched by Elemental HERO Flame Wingman - Infernal Rage: places HERO materials from your hand, field, GY, or banishment on the bottom of your Deck to summon Shining Neos Wingman on the opponent's turn!
extra: Xtra HERO Cross Crusader

Signature Link-2 DARK Warrior (2 Warrior monsters): when Link Summoned, targets 1 'Destiny HERO' monster in your GY and Special Summons it; tributes 1 'Destiny HERO' monster to add ANY 'HERO' monster with a different name from your Deck to your hand!
Xtra HERO Wonder Driver

Signature Link-2 LIGHT Warrior (2 'HERO' monsters): if a 'HERO' monster is Normal or Special Summoned to a zone this card points to, targets 1 'Polymerization' Spell, 'Fusion' Spell, or 'Change' Quick-Play Spell in your GY and Sets it to your field!
Xtra HERO Infernal Devicer

Signature Link-2 DARK Fiend (2 'HERO' monsters): when Link Summoned, reveals 1 'HERO' Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck to add up to 2 of the Fusion Materials whose names are specifically listed on that card from your Deck to your hand, and boosts Fiend/HERO monsters it points to!
Xtra HERO Dread Decimator

Signature Link-3 DARK Warrior boss (2+ 'HERO' monsters; 2500 ATK): this card, and any 'HERO' monsters it points to, gain 100 ATK for each 'HERO' monster with different names in your GY, and inflicts piercing battle damage!
Destiny HERO - Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer

Level 8 DARK Warrior Fusion boss: reduces opposing monsters' ATK, and destroys 1 card you control and 1 card on the field as a Quick Effect while reviving a Destiny HERO during the next Standby Phase!
Elemental HERO Sunrise

Level 7 LIGHT Warrior Fusion (2 HERO monsters with different Attributes): searches 'Miracle Fusion' on Special Summon (to be reused with Xtra HERO Wonder Driver!) and pops a card when another HERO declares an attack.
Elemental HERO Flame Wingman - Infernal Rage
Level 6 WIND Warrior Fusion: searches 'Favorite Contact' on Special Summon.
Elemental HERO Shining Neos Wingman

Level 8 LIGHT Warrior Fusion boss ('Elemental HERO Neos' + 1 'Wingman' Fusion Monster; revealed by Xtra HERO Infernal Devicer to search Elemental HERO Neos!): cannot be destroyed by card effects and pops cards up to the number of Attributes on the field!
Masked HERO Dark Law

Level 6 DARK Warrior Fusion (summoned via Mask Change and reset via Xtra HERO Wonder Driver!) that applies a one-sided Macro Cosmos to your opponent and banishes a card from their hand when they search.
Wake Up Your Elemental HERO
Level 10 LIGHT Warrior Fusion boss that gains 300 ATK per material, makes multiple attacks on monsters, and destroys all monsters your opponent controls if destroyed.
Vision HERO Trinity
Level 8 Fusion: doubles ATK to 5000 on summon and can attack up to 3 times on monsters during each Battle Phase.
